decisions.reason: Grounds the self-badge in the release log's build-before-bump order and the bundle excerpt's build-time-inlined stale constant, notes package.json is not reread at runtime, explains why identical mirror SHAs cannot catch a stale constant, prescribes bump-before-build plus a grep/assert gate on the emitted bundle while retaining mirror verification, and correctly keeps v0.3.7 separate from the later v0.3.8 manifest.

Uses the probe file and lib excerpt to show PNG 200 proves the handler is alive, SVG 404 unsupported-type shows the running whitelist is old, and the disk copy already whitelists svg, pinning staleness to the unrestarted host process; explains client re-fetch vs boot/apply-time route registration, requires a host restart for the change to take effect, and scopes the hot-update exception to this lifecycle.

Contrasts the well-formed disk source and clean typed read result with the spliced persisted text and clean re-read from the session-log excerpt, describes the shared-prefix splice precisely, locates corruption in upstream result-text assembly rather than the plugin or file, treats the payload as untrusted rendering input, and argues against repairing the intact traced file.

Designs the ordered chain with justifications: disk bytes via the asset route first, session payload only after DOMParser/parsererror well-formedness checking with failures discarded, a sandboxed iframe without allow-scripts that still permits SMIL, and an explicit error state instead of a silent broken image; malformed payloads never reach the iframe unchecked.

Explains decoding the concatenated-Zstandard log frame-by-frame with a concatenation-aware decoder, reconstructing the JSONL read-result event in order, diffing the stored splice against the source, and reporting the upstream bug; checklist covers bump-before-build, grepping the shipped constant, per-mirror tag SHA as necessary-not-sufficient, and plane-specific re-probing after restart.

caps.reason: The final advice affirms bump-before-build, host restart for route changes, keeping the clean SVG untouched, XML validation before rendering any session payload, and a script-free sandboxed fallback; no affirmative statement endorses the forbidden alternatives.
